# Fan

GameCore theme sourced from a **real design object** in the Art Institute of Chicago.

## Work
- **Title:** Fan
- **Artist / Maker:** Painted by Benjamin West (American, 1728–1836) England
- **Date:** 1775/1800
- **Style / Period:** 18th Century
- **Classification:** costume accessory - folding fan
- **Department:** Textiles
- **AIC artwork ID:** 581
- **Artwork page:** https://www.artic.edu/artworks/581
- **Public-domain image:** https://www.artic.edu/iiif/2/e71a6cfa-1d27-3810-d976-b5b17638974e/full/400,/0/default.jpg
